name: TomTom Maps
tagline: Global maps, search, routing, and traffic APIs for location apps
description: TomTom Maps is a commercial location platform offering map display, geocoding, places search, routing, traffic, and EV services via REST APIs. Developers use API keys with HTTPS endpoints under api.tomtom.com for navigation, logistics, and location-aware products.

auth.details: API key as query param key= or header; free self-serve developer account

pricing.free_tier_limits: Recurring free monthly requests per API (no card): Geocoding 20K; Reverse Geocoding 20K; Routing 20K; legacy Search 2.5K; Map Display Vector Tiles 200K; other products vary — docs.tomtom.com/pricing
pricing.paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go and enterprise plans via TomTom developer portal

rate_limits: Product-specific QPS and daily limits; published in developer portal
use_cases: reverse geocode lat/lon to an address
get driving route between two points
get real-time traffic incidents on a route
